canonical_hashing.json_bytes: UTF-8 json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False); no trailing newline
canonical_hashing.list_order: preserved as scientifically meaningful; dictionary keys sorted only by canonical serializer
canonical_hashing.sha256: lowercase hexadecimal SHA256 over exactly json_bytes
canonical_hashing.tensor_payload_hash: SHA256(canonical JSON metadata bytes concatenated with raw tensor bytes), as frozen in sanity v1.1

claim_boundary: Prospective execution-authority successor only. It preserves ReplayResidual V2.2 scientific semantics exactly and changes only how a CUDA host is admitted and attested. It does not run model/environment science, inspect outcomes, or authorize provider lifecycle.

conflict_resolution.policy: Resolve prospectively by the frozen WorkItem 88ab2f5b specification and fidelity to the qualifier addendum for prompt/action semantics, while importing the packet contract all-32 atomic publication semantics and canonical sanity v1.1 controls/populations.

execution_capability_admission.admission_interpretation: A host is compatible iff objective runtime and stress-canary checks pass. GPU product name, provider offer, provider instance ID and local-vs-remote location are not admission criteria. A compatible RTX3080/3090/4090 or future CUDA GPU may pass; any named GPU may fail if capability/headroom checks fail.

candidate_suffix.text: single ASCII space + exact admissible command

chat_template.shared_prefix_rule: the returned assistant-generation prefix is identical for every candidate at the same step

executor.choice: maximum score; exact numerical tie -> lexicographically smallest exact admissible command
executor.commands_serialization: sort current admissible command strings lexicographically; serialize one command per line exactly as returned by AlfRuntime, no numbering and no filtering
executor.history_serialization: empty string before action1; after each step append exactly STEP {i}\nACTION: {command}\nOBSERVATION: {observation}; join steps with newline; keep original model-own plan_text visible verbatim on every action prompt
executor.invalid_command_policy: TECHNICAL_INVALID; no retry or heuristic rescue

score.definition: arithmetic mean teacher-forced suffix-token log probability over suffix positions only
score.logits_conversion: convert logits to FP32 before log_softmax; model weights remain BF16

executor.system: You are executing an ALFWorld household task. The visible plan is advisory state from your own earlier planning turn. Choose the single best current admissible command to continue the task. Do not invent actions or hidden facts.
executor.termination: stop immediately on won or done, otherwise after 12 executed environment actions

observable_input_contract.admissible_commands_source: live AlfRuntime.admissible_commands at each action step
observable_input_contract.hidden_facts_policy: may contribute only to AlfRuntime state_hash/replay identity; never serialized to model prompt or packet-visible observation beyond the hash
observable_input_contract.task_instruction_source: extract exactly from live initial TextWorld observation using the final occurrence matching /Your task is to:\s*(.+?)(?:\n|$)/i; normalized task instruction is captured text stripped, with terminal punctuation preserved; extraction failure => unqualified/technical packet, no alternate metadata source

output_semantics.private_staging_dir_rule: same parent, unique hidden .inprogress directory not visible as final target
publication_sequence: write all 32 fixed-index packets plus manifest and aggregate provenance
validate exact packet index set equals 0..31 and all canonical hashes
require every fixed attempt represented including unqualified attempts
atomically rename staging directory to final target only if final target absent
output_semantics.stdout_policy: coarse count progress only; no per-family plan/action/qualification outcomes

packet_schema.unqualified_policy: emit one packet for every frozen index with explicit reasons; never skip or replace

new_token_decode.postprocess: strip leading/trailing whitespace only; no other normalization

planner.system: You are planning an ALFWorld household task. Produce a concise ordered plan using only information in the task instruction and initial observation. Do not reveal chain-of-thought or hidden reasoning. Do not invent hidden world facts. Output only one <PLAN>...</PLAN> block.

population.game_path_source: fresh cohort manifest game_path only; no discovery or outcome-dependent substitution

prohibitions: design/materialization only: no model calls or ALFWorld study execution
no scientific outcome access or future split access
do not mutate or reinterpret ReplayResidual V2.2 Experiment e9a95d91-7b68-4ffc-9f1c-ec3dc5c3c6e9
do not add exact GPU marketing-name equality as an admission criterion
do not use provider offer/instance identity as scientific authority
do not relax model revision/dtype/quantization/offload/runtime/scientific protocol to make a host pass
do not interpret runtime canary pass/fail as scientific evidence

qualification.stage1: After all fixed indices0..31 have been attempted, freeze E as exactly the trajectory-eligible families. Do not replace, rescue, or alter E afterward.

control_builder.failure: qualified=false for affected fixed family; no replacement

stage2.if_E_size_lt_2: no family may become final qualified; final result is INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_NATURAL_TRAJECTORIES

unrelated_plan_donor_rule.selection: sort E by ordering_key ascending; for each recipient take the next cyclic entry whose family differs; no alternate donor, no rescue, no outcome matching

registered_execution_authority_delta.interpretation: Prospective execution portability/attestation change only; scientific protocol and estimand are unchanged.

registration_and_authority.successor_requirement: Register ONE NEW ReplayResidual V2.3 Experiment/Prediction only after this capability-bound design receives one independent batched review PASS, the deterministic capability validator is frozen, a live host passes the exact-model stress canary with required headroom, artifact durability is ready, and a fresh ResearchDecision is created. No exact GPU product name may be added back as an admission criterion without a new prospective design because device identity is not a scientific variable here.

replay_conditions.ALT_NEUTRAL_POSITION: independent neutral filler vocabulary/seed, exact128 tokens, same slot and positions
replay_conditions.GENERIC_HISTORY: deterministic transcript-derived non-plan facts from already-visible pre-anchor observations/actions + neutral padding, exact128 tokens
replay_conditions.NEXT_ACTION_PRESERVED_LATE_NULL: same exact first post-anchor realized admissible action string included verbatim in the fixed plan slot; all later plan structure replaced by deterministic unrelated/neutral clauses; exact128 tokens. This preserves immediate-action lexical evidence while destroying longer-horizon plan structure.
replay_conditions.PLAN_PRESENT: original model-generated plan content + neutral padding to exact128 tokens
replay_conditions.SHUFFLED_PLAN: same plan step clauses under deterministic SHA256 permutation + neutral padding, exact128 tokens
replay_conditions.UNRELATED_PLAN: deterministic different-family plan from fixed frozen trajectory-eligible E only, selected by the predeclared cyclic SHA256 order in qualification.stage2.unrelated_plan_donor_rule; final-qualified membership never participates in donor selection; content max96 then neutral padding to exact128; no outcome matching

runtime_attestation.required_actual_fields_semantics: Self-contained list of every attestation key consumed by replayresidual_v23_capability_validator_a1.py; missing keys fail closed before any registration, Decision, model science, or provider action.

anchors.t1: after first completed post-plan action-observation cycle
anchors.t2: after second completed post-plan action-observation cycle; must precede the frozen interruption/reset point

sanity_binding.capture_token: last token immediately before the next ACTION: field at each anchor

frozen_sanity_gate.failure_interpretation: matched non-plan/position controls explain the replay residual or content identity is not stable enough; kill ReplayResidual before causal injection search
frozen_sanity_gate.pass_interpretation: representation sanity only; permits a separately preregistered bounded causal discovery but is NOT evidence of causal plan restoration/persistence
requirements: at least 70% of qualified families have family_aggregate_margin > 0
median same-plan temporal cosine exceeds median ALT_NEUTRAL_POSITION cosine by >=0.10
median across-layer same-family retrieval top1 accuracy >=0.25
median same-plan temporal cosine exceeds median NEXT_ACTION_PRESERVED_LATE_NULL cosine by >=0.05

sanity_binding.normalization: retain raw FP32 residual for norm statistics; use L2-unit residual only for cosine/selectivity metrics; norm<=1e-8 maps to zero vector and is a failure for positive-selectivity family, never excluded

primary_metrics.family_aggregate_margin: median across the four frozen layers; no layer selection
primary_metrics.retrieval_secondary: for each frozen layer, query r_PLAN_i(t1) against all r_PLAN_j(t2); same-family top1 accuracy, leave-all-families-in, no training

sanity_binding.site: residual stream output of frozen transformer block
sanity_binding.trajectory_invariant: teacher-force the exact same realized action-observation trajectory in every replay arm; only the fixed 128-token plan block differs

trajectory.run: uninterrupted with the model-own retained plan visible until won/done or 12 actions
trajectory_eligible_iff: first two executed commands are nontrivial
at least two commands after action2 are nontrivial

validator_integrity_repair.repair_scope: Validator/schema integrity only; no scientific protocol variable, estimand, capability-admission policy, headroom threshold, provider policy, model runtime, population, control, metric or output semantics changed.
review_findings_repaired: Validator now recomputes canonical_object_sha256_without_self_field and fails closed on contract semantic/hash drift.
Validator now checks all exact_model_stress_canary authority fields, including study/future/environment access, slot geometry, hook cardinality, and exact Qwen runtime semantics.
